title: Evidence Completeness and Verification Surface
objective: Map every capability registry entry to its available evidence, verification state, provenance, and unresolved gaps without changing authoritative sources.
included_scope: Verification state, confidence, and provenance display
excluded_scope: Automated trust assertions beyond verified evidence
success_criteria: Every registry entry has an evidence state and source reference.
Every entry includes a verification method and commit reference or explicit UNKNOWN.
CI rejects missing evidence references and unsupported provenance.
